$comment: Machine-local SC-05 git catalog (ARTHUR_GIT_CONFIG points here). Copy to a git-ignored machine-local path and set ARTHUR_GIT_CONFIG to it. Uses the exact GitCapabilityConfig schema: repo entries bind repo_id -> { label, root_id (SC-04 scope), path (scope-relative, never absolute), allowed_modes }. No auto-discovery, no model-provided paths.
